generalPanel.kidAgeBandHint: Controls wording, reply length, responders per turn, read-aloud default and available games.
generalPanel.kidModelHint: All built-in companions use this model. When unset, the first available provider is used.
generalPanel.kidModelEmpty: No model provider yet. Add one under Providers first.
generalPanel.kidClearMemoryConfirm: Clear the nickname and interests companions remember?
generalPanel.kidClearChatsConfirm: Clear all chat history in kids mode?
generalPanel.speechTtsHint: "Token Plan" uses a Qwen Token Plan key (starts with sk-sp-). "Realtime" uses a pay-as-you-go Model Studio key and offers more child voices. Falls back to the system voice on errors.
generalPanel.speechAsrHint: "Token Plan" transcribes the whole clip after release; "Realtime" shows text while speaking. Both need microphone access.
generalPanel.speechKeyPlaceholder: Paste a Token Plan (sk-sp-) or Model Studio API key
generalPanel.speechKeyHint: The key is stored encrypted on this device, used only for speech requests and never shown to the child.
generalPanel.speechVoiceAuto: Each companion's own voice; or type a voice ID
generalPanel.speechPreviewText: Hi there, I'm your little buddy. What shall we talk about today?
generalPanel.speechEndpointHint: Pick a preset or enter a workspace-specific endpoint, e.g. wss://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/inference
generalPanel.speechTokenPlanHint: Token Plan currently offers qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus for synthesis and qwen-audio-3.0-asr-flash for recognition.
generalPanel.speechVoiceHint: Leave empty to give each companion its own child voice, or enter any voice ID from the voice list.
generalPanel.speechVoiceTokenPlanHint: qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus only has two system voices (longanlingxin, longanlufeng) and no child voices; you can also enter one of its base voice IDs (qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus-xxx).
generalPanel.speechInstructionHint: Tells the model how to sound, e.g. "like a kindergarten teacher telling a story". Leave empty to disable.
generalPanel.speechCompanionVoicesHint: Pick from the list or type any voice ID (e.g. a cloned or designed voice). Games follow their host when empty; companions follow the default voice. Saved separately for each model.
generalPanel.speechDialogHint: When chatting with a single companion via push-to-talk, the Qwen-Audio realtime model listens and answers directly with lower latency. The playground and games keep using recognition + read-aloud above.
generalPanel.speechDialogSafetyHint: Realtime replies are spoken by the model directly, before any text review; the safety rules and persona are still sent as instructions. Falls back to the normal voice pipeline if it cannot connect.
